title: Call Tape Embedding
statement: For natural numbers $v$, $i$, and $p$, define an injective map from the indices $0,\ldots,2v$ to the tape indices $0,\ldots,3+2v+2i+2p-1$. It sends $0$ to $1$ and each positive index $j$ to $j+2$.
